identity.title: Safety Data Sheet — Sodium Hydroxide Solution, 50%

scan.summary: This is a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for sodium hydroxide solution 50% prepared by the supplier Northwest Alkali Products, Inc., in compliance with OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200). It is a supplier's document, not Cascade Specialty Chemicals' own document—it does not represent a standard, policy, or permit that Cascade holds, but rather is provided by the vendor to inform Cascade's handling and storage of this chemical. Cascade's responsibility is to ensure this SDS is available to its workers and that operations comply with the precautions and exposure limits it specifies.
scan.freshness_note: The SDS was revised on March 18, 2024, which is current as of today (September 25, 2026). No expiry date is set for an SDS; however, it should be reviewed periodically to ensure it remains accurate and reflects any changes to the product or regulations.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all identity and factual elements—this is a standard SDS issued by the supplier on a stated date and version. This is a supplier document and is not subject to gaps analysis. No defects in the SDS itself are apparent; it follows the GHS format required by OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200. The document is clearly readable. The only uncertainty is whether Cascade's own operations and labeling fully implement the hazards and precautions described—that is Cascade's responsibility, not the supplier's, and is not in scope for this document review. Cascade should verify that employees are trained on this SDS and that workplace controls (eyewash/shower, ventilation, protective equipment, container materials) are in place.
